title: ...respond to severe arterial or deep wound bleeding
desc: Control life-threatening blood loss before paramedics arrive.
sourceName: Stop The Bleed / American College of Surgeons
todos: Call 911 immediately and ensure scene safety before approaching.
Apply firm, continuous direct pressure to wound using clean cloth or sterile gauze.
Pack deep wounds tightly with sterile gauze or clean cloth while maintaining pressure.
Apply tourniquet 2â€“3 inches above wound on arm or leg if bleeding does not stop.
Keep victim calm and covered with blanket to prevent medical shock.
